summary: Proposal for memory optimization improvements in Temporal's metrics handling, featuring two-layer caching to reduce allocations in tallyMetricsHandler that eliminate 10.6% of total memory allocations and provide up to 2.6% latency improvements.
userImpact: Users benefit from reduced memory usage and improved latency in metrics collection for high-throughput Temporal deployments.
rootCause: Repeated map allocations and tally scope registry lookups on every metric emission due to lack of caching at multiple levels.
proposedFix: Implement two-layer caching in tallyMetricsHandler: (1) sync.Map-based caching of WithTags handler children, (2) bounded scopeCache (1024 entries) for Tagged scope lookups with normalized tags to avoid repeated allocations.
keyQuote: While trying to improve Tempoal performance for ScyllaDB I bumped across mostly unrelated memory optimizations opportunities. Is the team interested in them?
